Caribou move through this landscape, and Naskapi knowledge recalls their presence near the Sérigny River in spring. The river joins the Caniapiscau, whose waters continue north to the Koksoak and Ungava Bay.
simp_chinese: 米斯塔尼皮意为“大湖”，是纳斯卡皮人对北方内陆塞里尼湖的称呼。湖泊与周围高原位于卡尼亚皮斯考地区，是纳斯卡皮人生计的重要区域。驯鹿迁徙穿过这片土地，纳斯卡皮人的知识记得春季有时可在塞里尼河附近见到鹿群。塞里尼河汇入卡尼亚皮斯考河，水流继续向北通往科克索阿克河和昂加瓦湾。

english: The Mistassibi, whose Innu name means “great river”, flows south from the lake country north of Pekuakami. It joins the Mistassini before the combined waters enter Lac Saint-Jean. For Ilnu families, the river formed part of an extensive inland network linking the lake basin to hunting territories and watersheds farther north. Rapids punctuate its course through the forest, while its tributaries reach towards the lakes of the northern plateau.
simp_chinese: 米斯塔西比在因努语中意为“大河”，从佩夸卡米以北的湖区向南流去。它与米斯塔西尼河汇合后，河水流入圣让湖。对伊尔努家庭而言，这条河属于广阔的内陆交通网络，将湖区与更北方的猎场及流域相连。河道穿过森林，途中有急流，支流则伸向北部高原的湖泊。

english: The Mistassini Hills are a country of roughly parallel ridges and valleys, some of them filled by the long waters of Lake Mistassini. Glaciers helped shape the hills and the many lakes scattered across the surrounding plateau. The lake lies in the lower southern part of this broad upland region, within the Rupert River watershed. Cree people have lived around Mistassini and along the waters leading from it towards James Bay for thousands of years.
simp_chinese: 米斯塔西尼山区的山脊和谷地大致平行排列，一些谷地被狭长的米斯塔西尼湖水填满。冰川塑造了山丘，也留下了散布在周围高原上的众多湖泊。米斯塔西尼湖位于这片广阔高地较低的南部，属于鲁珀特河流域。数千年来，克里人生活在湖区及通往詹姆斯湾的水道沿岸。

sources.title: 191 SWP- 1970 Physiographic Subdivisions of Canada (ID 191) OCR.pdf

english: Mistassiniish is the Cree name for the long lake east of Lake Mistassini, known in French as Lake Albanel. The Témiscamie River reaches its eastern shore, and its waters continue towards Mistassini and the Rupert River. In 1672, on an island in the lower Témiscamie, the Jesuit Charles Albanel met Sebisaouat, an elder chief of the Mistassini people, during his journey towards James Bay. The lake later took the missionary's name.
simp_chinese: 米斯塔西尼什是米斯塔西尼湖以东那片狭长湖泊的克里语名称，法语称之为阿尔巴内尔湖。泰米斯卡米河流入湖泊东岸，湖水再流向米斯塔西尼湖和鲁珀特河。1672年，耶稣会士夏尔·阿尔巴内尔前往詹姆斯湾途中，在泰米斯卡米河下游的一座岛上会见了米斯塔西尼人的年长酋长塞比萨瓦。后来，这片湖泊以传教士的名字命名。

english: Mistecapiu, an Innu name meaning “steep rock”, belongs to a river and lake in the wooded country north of the St Lawrence. The river descends towards the estuary through a course broken by rapids. French maps later called it the Pentecôte: the name appears on a map by Jacques-Nicolas Bellin in 1744. The Innu name recalls the rocky landscape through which the waters run to the coast.
simp_chinese: 米斯特卡皮乌在因努语中意为“陡峭的岩石”，是圣劳伦斯河北岸森林中一条河流和一座湖的名称。河水经多处急流奔向河口。法国地图后来将它称为潘特科特河；雅克-尼古拉·贝兰1744年的地图上便可见此名。因努语名称则让人想起河水流向海岸时经过的岩石地貌。

english:
Mistelbach grew around a castle and a crossing of roads in Lower Austria's Weinviertel. The lords of Mistelbach held the castle as vassals of the Babenbergs; in 1372 the settlement became a market and received the right to hold an annual fair. Its inhabitants gained burgher status, and a wall with four gates enclosed the market. The Liechtenstein family acquired the lordship in 1383.

Mistelbach suffered devastation during the Hussite Wars in 1426. During the Thirty Years' War, the Swedish commander Lennart Torstensson made the town hall his headquarters in 1645; the ensuing occupation left more than half the houses destroyed. In 1665 the local community disputed the Liechtenstein lordship's seizure of a large forest. After documents proved the town's claim, the forest was returned.
simp_chinese:
米斯特尔巴赫围绕下奥地利葡萄酒区的一座城堡和道路交会处发展起来。米斯特尔巴赫领主作为巴本堡家族的封臣拥有城堡；1372年，聚落成为集镇并获得举办年市的权利。居民取得市民身份，四门城墙环绕集镇。1383年，列支敦士登家族取得当地领地。

1426年胡斯战争期间，米斯特尔巴赫遭到破坏。三十年战争中，瑞典将领伦纳特·托斯滕松于1645年将市政厅设为指挥部；随后的占领使半数以上房屋被毁。1665年，当地居民与列支敦士登领主因一片被侵占的大森林发生争执。在文书证明城镇的权利后，森林归还了居民。

english: Mistimakan is an island on the eastern side of James Bay, within the Cree homeland of Eeyou Istchee. Its low shores face a shallow sea where tides uncover extensive flats and winter ice closes the coast. Migrating geese, ducks and shorebirds gather along the bay, while rivers from the wooded interior enter between its islands and inlets. The Cree name identifies one place within a coastline shaped by seasonal movement of water, ice and wildlife.
simp_chinese: 米斯蒂马坎是詹姆斯湾东侧的一座岛屿，属于克里人的埃尤伊斯奇家园。低矮岛岸面向浅海，退潮露出广阔滩地，冬季海冰封住海岸。迁徙的雁、鸭和滨鸟在湾边聚集，来自内陆森林的河流则穿过岛屿和水湾注入海中。这个克里语地名指向一处由潮水、冰和野生动物季节性变化塑造的海岸。

english: Mistinatuakamau, “good large lake” in Naskapi, is the southern part of a long lake on the George River. The lake is also known as Mushuau Nipi, the lake of the treeless country, and its two sections are joined by a short passage. The surrounding interior was home to the Mushuau Innu, whose hunting grounds centred on the lake and the caribou that travelled through the region. Their routes connected this inland country with the Labrador coast.
simp_chinese: 米斯蒂纳图阿卡毛在纳斯卡皮语中意为“美丽的大湖”，是乔治河上一座狭长湖泊的南部。整座湖也称穆舒奥尼皮，即“无树之地的湖”，南北两部分由一条短水道相连。周围内陆是穆舒奥因努人的家园，湖泊及途经此地的驯鹿是他们狩猎地域的中心；道路由此通往拉布拉多海岸。

english: Mistinatwayasu is a Naskapi name meaning “great lake by the river.” It is applied to more than one lake in the northern Labrador interior, including the lake known as Mistamisk. The name describes a landscape of broad waters and connecting rivers in the homeland of the Innu. Northern Innu communities placed particular importance on caribou hunting, travelling across the peninsula's interior as the animals moved between their seasonal grounds.
simp_chinese: 米斯蒂纳特瓦亚苏是纳斯卡皮语名称，意为“河边的大湖”。拉布拉多半岛北部内陆不止一座湖使用这个名字，其中包括米斯塔米斯克湖。名称描绘了因努故土中宽阔湖泊与相连河流组成的景观。北方因努社群尤其重视猎取驯鹿，随着鹿群在季节猎场之间移动，穿行于半岛内陆。

english:
Mistassini stands near the southeastern end of the great lake of the same name, in a homeland long inhabited by Cree families. The lake's shores served as gathering places, while its waters supplied fish and offered routes into the surrounding country. Its name, meaning “big rock,” recalls the great stones of the region. The lake drains through the Rupert River, which carries its waters westward to James Bay.

French traders established a post on Lake Mistassini in the later seventeenth century. Its site moved more than once, and in 1821 the Hudson's Bay Company established a post at the place that became Mistissini. Canoe brigades connected the lake with the trading post at the mouth of the Rupert River, far to the west on James Bay.
simp_chinese:
米斯塔西尼位于同名大湖东南端附近，地处克里家族世代生活的土地。湖岸是人们聚会的地方，湖水提供鱼获，也为前往周围地区开辟了道路。湖名意为“大石头”，使人想起这一带的巨石。湖水经鲁珀特河向西流入詹姆斯湾。

十七世纪后半叶，法国商人在米斯塔西尼湖设立商站。站址几经迁移，1821年哈德逊湾公司在后来成为米斯蒂西尼聚落的地点设站。独木舟船队将湖区与远在西面、詹姆斯湾鲁珀特河口的商站联系起来。

english:
Mistretta stands among the wooded mountains of northern Sicily, beneath the remains of a castle that overlooks the town. Its streets grew on the slopes below the fortress, enclosed by defensive walls and gates, including the gate known as Porta Palermo. The settlement prospered through agriculture and trade, and its churches bear the work of local stonecutters as well as members of the Gagini family.

Mistretta joined the Sicilian Vespers against Angevin rule in 1282 and later became a royal town under the Aragonese. In 1447 Alfonso confirmed its royal status and allowed artisans a role in its government. The sixteenth century brought new religious and civic buildings, including a hospital and a house for pilgrims, while the town's craftsmen enriched its principal church.
simp_chinese:
米斯特雷塔坐落在西西里北部林木茂密的山地中，城堡遗迹俯瞰着镇上。街巷沿堡垒下方的山坡展开，昔日有城墙和城门环绕，其中包括巴勒莫门。农业与贸易使聚落繁荣，教堂保留着当地石匠和加吉尼家族成员的作品。

1282年，米斯特雷塔加入反抗安茹统治的西西里晚祷起义，后来成为阿拉贡统治下的王室直属城镇。1447年，阿方索确认其直属地位，并允许工匠参与市政。十六世纪，当地增建宗教和公共建筑，包括医院及朝圣者之家，工匠也装饰了主教堂。

english: Mistutikumak is a Cree name meaning big whitefish, recorded for a lake in northern Manitoba. A nearby river bears the same name and belongs to a network of lakes and streams reaching the Churchill River. In this northern country, waterways wind through forest and wet ground, joining one lake to another. Whitefish give the name a character of its own, recalling the fish that have long sustained people in the inland waters.
simp_chinese: 米斯图蒂库马克是曼尼托巴北部一个湖泊的克里语名称，意为“大白鲑”。附近一条河也有相同名称，属于最终通向丘吉尔河的湖泊与溪流网络。在这片北方土地上，水道蜿蜒穿过森林和湿地，将一个湖泊与另一个湖泊连接起来。白鲑赋予地名鲜明的特色，也让人想起内陆水域长期供养人们的鱼类。

english:
The Mitchigamea were one of the peoples associated with the Illinois, living at different times along the Mississippi and its tributaries. In 1673 Jacques Marquette and Louis Jolliet encountered a Mitchigamea community in the country north of the Quapaw. They later lived among the Kaskaskia before establishing a village near the French Fort de Chartres in the Mississippi bottomlands.

In June 1752 a war party led by the Sauk attacked the village near the fort, killing many inhabitants and destroying their homes. The village had given shelter to Cahokia people, who were also enemies of the attackers. The survivors established another village nearby. The Mitchigamea later became closely associated with the Kaskaskia, and by 1803 the United States recognized them as part of that people.
simp_chinese:
米契加米亚人与伊利诺伊人关系密切，不同时期居住在密西西比河及其支流沿岸。1673年，雅克·马凯特和路易·若利埃在夸保人领地以北遇到一处米契加米亚社群。此后他们曾与卡斯卡斯基亚人共同居住，又在密西西比河低地的法国沙特尔堡附近建立村庄。

1752年六月，一支以索克人为首的战队袭击堡垒附近的村庄，杀害许多居民并毁坏房屋。村庄此前为卡霍基亚人提供庇护，而后者也是袭击者的敌人。幸存者在附近另建村庄。米契加米亚人与卡斯卡斯基亚人的联系后来愈发密切，到1803年美国已将他们认作卡斯卡斯基亚人的一部分。

english: Mithankot stands on the western bank of the Indus, below its meeting with the Panjnad, the combined waters of Punjab's rivers. The junction has not always been in the same place. In 1790 the Indus changed its course, moving its meeting with the Punjab rivers from Uch to the vicinity of Mithankot. The shift exposed Nahar lands north of the old riverbed to attacks by the Daudputras, showing how a change in the great river could alter the boundaries of power as well as the channels of the plain.
simp_chinese: 米坦科特位于印度河西岸，在印度河与潘杰纳德河汇合处的下游。潘杰纳德汇集了旁遮普诸河的水流，但两河交汇的位置并非一成不变。1790年，印度河改变河道，与旁遮普诸河的汇合点从乌奇移至米坦科特附近。旧河床以北的纳哈尔领地因此暴露在达乌德普特拉人的进攻之下；大河改道不仅改变了平原水系，也改变了权力的边界。

english: Mithri lies in the Kachhi plain southeast of Sibi. The nearby ruins of Mirzapur are associated with the Baruzai chiefs, who held the old town before Kachhi was transferred to the khan of Kalat in 1740. According to local accounts, the Baruzai chiefs then moved their headquarters to Sibi, while inhabitants established Mithri nearby. The settlement formed part of a plain watered by seasonal streams descending from the mountains.
simp_chinese: 米特里位于锡比东南的卡奇平原。附近米尔扎布尔遗址与巴鲁扎伊首领有关，他们在1740年卡奇转交卡拉特汗之前掌有这座旧城。据地方记载，巴鲁扎伊首领随后将驻地迁往锡比，居民则在附近建立米特里。聚落所在平原由从山地流下的季节性溪流供水。

english: Mitic was a Tecuexe settlement in the highlands of western Mexico, near Teocaltiche and Jalostotitlán. Colonial records place it among the indigenous communities of the district of Lagos. In the sixteenth century it also gave its name to an ecclesiastical jurisdiction, separated from Teocaltiche in 1572; Jalostotitlán later became its permanent seat. The frontier remained unsettled, and a report from 1568 described attacks on villages and maize fields.
simp_chinese: 米蒂克是西墨西哥高地的一处特奎克塞人聚落，靠近特奥卡尔蒂切和哈洛斯托蒂特兰。殖民记录将它列为拉戈斯辖区的原住民社区之一。十六世纪，它还为一个教会辖区命名：该辖区于1572年从特奥卡尔蒂切分出，后来以哈洛斯托蒂特兰为固定中心。边境局势仍不安定，1568年一份报告记载村庄与玉米田遭到袭击。

english: Mitijangazanmo is a great salt lake in the interior of the Tibetan plateau. The Tanggula and Zurken Ula mountains enclose its basin, and streams fed by glaciers enter its waters. To the southwest lies Dorsotung Lake, which has been connected to it at times of high water. Their shores lie in a cold, dry country close to the sources of the Yangtze.
simp_chinese: 米提江阿杂莫错是青藏高原腹地的一座大盐湖，又称赤布张错。唐古拉山和祖尔肯乌拉山环抱湖盆，冰川融水形成的河流注入湖中。西南的多尔索洞错在高水位时曾与它相连；两湖周边寒冷干燥，靠近长江源区。

english: On the eastern shore of Lesbos, Mytilene grew around two harbors once linked by a channel. In antiquity it became the leading city of the island and the home of the poets Sappho and Alcaeus. Its castle rose above the port, guarding a city whose maritime connections reached the nearby Anatolian coast. In 1355 the Byzantine emperor John V granted Lesbos to the Genoese Francesco Gattilusio, who married his sister Maria. The Gattilusi renovated the fortress in 1373 and ruled the island until 1462, when Sultan Mehmed II besieged and captured Mytilene. More than two centuries later, in 1690, Venetian ships defeated Ottoman and Barbary vessels in a battle off the city.
simp_chinese: 米蒂利尼位于莱斯博斯岛东岸，围绕两个曾由水道相连的港口发展起来。古代它成为岛上的主要城市，也是诗人萨福和阿尔凯俄斯的故乡。城堡高踞港口之上，守护着这座与附近安纳托利亚海岸有海上联系的城市。1355年，拜占庭皇帝约翰五世将莱斯博斯授予热那亚人弗朗切斯科·加蒂卢西奥，后者娶了皇帝的妹妹玛丽亚。加蒂卢西奥家族于1373年修缮要塞，统治该岛直到1462年苏丹穆罕默德二世围攻并占领米蒂利尼。两个多世纪后的1690年，威尼斯舰船在城外海战中击败奥斯曼和巴巴里舰船。

english: Mitimiri lies in the lower Rufiji country, where the river and its floodplain connect inland East Africa with the Swahili coast. Seasonal water levels shape cultivation, fishing and movement across the wider region. During the medieval and early modern periods, the East African coast was linked with Indian Ocean commerce, and goods passed through networks joining inland communities with coastal merchants. Islamic influences interacted with diverse local traditions.
simp_chinese: 米蒂米里位于鲁菲吉河下游，大河与洪泛平原连接东非内陆和斯瓦希里海岸。季节水位影响耕作、捕鱼和交通。中世纪至近代早期，东非海岸与印度洋商业相连，货物经由网络在内陆社群与沿海商人之间流动，伊斯兰影响也与多样的地方传统互动。

english: The Mitis River reaches the southern shore of the St. Lawrence between Rimouski and Matane. Wolastoqiyik and Mi'kmaq people visited its mouth, where salmon and eels could be caught, and the river led inland toward their wider territories. In 1675 the French granted the seigneury of Mitis to Jean-Baptiste de Peiras; other grants followed near the river. Settlement on these lands developed slowly, becoming more substantial only in the early nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 米蒂斯河在里穆斯基与马塔讷之间注入圣劳伦斯河南岸。沃拉斯托基人与米克马克人曾到访河口，捕捞鲑鱼和鳗鱼；河流也通往他们更广阔的内陆地域。1675年，法国将米蒂斯领地授予让-巴蒂斯特·德·佩拉，随后又在河附近授出其他领地。这些土地的定居发展缓慢，直到十九世纪初才逐渐扩大。

english: Mitoyo lies on the coast of western Sanuki, where salt making became a prominent industry. At Nio, salt fields were developed along the shore, and their produce travelled by boat to Kawanoe and inland toward Awa. Boats that brought pine leaves for fuel carried salt on their return journeys. In the 1830s new salt fields were laid out at Nio, adding to the long-established industry of the Inland Sea coast.
simp_chinese: 三丰位于赞岐西部海岸，制盐曾是当地重要产业。仁尾的海滨开辟了盐田，产盐由船运往川之江，再进入阿波内陆。船只运来烧盐用的松叶，返航时则装载食盐。十九世纪三十年代，仁尾又开辟新盐田，延续了濑户内海沿岸的制盐传统。

english: The fortress of Zvečan crowns a steep hill above the Ibar, near its meeting with the Sitnica. It guarded an important route through the lands of medieval Serbia and stood close to the mines of Trepča, where silver and lead brought wealth to the region. The fortress also served the Nemanjić rulers as a royal stronghold. In 1331 King Stefan Dečanski was imprisoned here after his son Dušan seized power; he died within its walls later that year.
simp_chinese: 兹韦钱要塞高踞伊巴尔河上方的陡丘，靠近西特尼察河汇入处。它守卫着穿过中世纪塞尔维亚领土的重要道路，附近特雷普查矿山的银和铅也为这一地区带来财富。要塞还是尼曼雅王朝的一处王室据点。1331年，斯特凡·德昌斯基国王在儿子杜尚夺权后被囚禁于此，同年晚些时候死在城墙之内。

english: The Yellowstone River rises in the Absaroka Mountains and flows into a high lake before turning north through forests and meadows. Below the lake it plunges over two great falls into a deep canyon, then continues towards the Missouri. The Hidatsa name for the river, rendered Mi tse a-da-zi, means “Rock Yellow River”. The surrounding high country was home to the Tukudika, a mountain Shoshone people who hunted bighorn sheep and gathered plants in the Yellowstone region.
simp_chinese: 黄石河发源于阿布萨罗卡山脉，流入高原湖泊后转向北方，穿过森林与草甸。河水出湖后越过两座大瀑布，落入深峡，再继续流向密苏里河。希达察人称这条河为米采阿达兹，意为“黄石河”。周围高地是图库迪卡人的家园；这支山地肖肖尼人在黄石地区猎取盘羊、采集植物。

english: Mitsiadazi is a recorded name for the Yellowstone River, the great stream flowing northeast from the mountains of Wyoming across Montana. Its name has been rendered as Yellow Rock River, corresponding to the French Roche Jaune and the English Yellowstone. The river gathers the waters of the Bighorn, Tongue and Powder rivers before joining the Missouri, linking mountain valleys with the northern Plains.
simp_chinese: 米齐亚达齐是黄石河的一个记载名称。这条大河从怀俄明山地向东北流过蒙大拿，其名称被译为“黄岩河”，与法语的罗什若讷和英语的黄石之名相对应。河流汇集比格霍恩河、通河与保德河的水流，最终注入密苏里河，将山谷与北部平原联系起来。

english:
The Mitsogo inhabit the forested high country between the Ngounié and its tributaries. Ridges rise above narrow valleys where streams rush down steep slopes, many too swift for canoes. The Mitsogo are associated with the initiation tradition known as Bwete, whose teachings were shared with neighbouring peoples. Its origins cannot be dated precisely, but by the nineteenth century it was already known across much of the southern country.

The later city of Koulamoutou lies here.
simp_chinese:
米佐戈人居住在恩古涅河及其支流之间林木覆盖的高地。山脊耸立于狭窄河谷之上，溪流从陡坡奔下，许多水道湍急得无法行舟。米佐戈人与称为布韦特的入会传统关系密切，其教义也传给邻近族群。它的起源难以确切断代，但到19世纪已在南部广大地区为人所知。

后来的库拉穆图即位于此地。

english: Mittaywanquam is a name recorded for the river later known as the Daaquam. It rises in the wooded uplands and flows northeast to join the Northwest Branch of the Saint John River. In an 1828 survey, Joseph Bouchette used the Indigenous name Mittaywanquam for this watercourse. The river runs through a region of forests and headwaters at the edge of the Saint John basin.
simp_chinese: 米塔万夸姆是后来称为达卡姆河的河流在文献中出现的名称。它发源于森林覆盖的高地，向东北流入圣约翰河西北支流。1828年，约瑟夫·布歇特在测绘报告中以原住民名称米塔万夸姆称呼这条河。河流穿过森林与源流密布的地区，位于圣约翰河流域边缘。

english:
Mittersill lies in the upper Salzach valley, near the route over the Felber Tauern. First recorded in 963, it was a market by 1308 and became an important centre for pack transport. Horses and mules carried salt, iron and copper south over the pass, returning with wine, fruit, velvet and silk. The lords of Felben, whose tower stood nearby, held influence in the region during the Middle Ages.

In 1495 a great landslide at the head of the Felber valley formed the Hintersee. Plague struck Mittersill in 1635, and a fire in 1746 destroyed almost the whole market and badly damaged the parish church. During the French wars, local militia fought alongside Tyroleans at the Strub Pass. Floods from the Salzach remained a recurring danger, prompting work on an embankment in the 1830s.
simp_chinese:
米特西尔位于萨尔察河上游谷地，靠近翻越费尔伯陶恩山口的道路。963年它首次见于文献，1308年已是集镇，并成为重要的驮运中心。马匹和骡子将盐、铁和铜越过山口运往南方，带回葡萄酒、水果、天鹅绒和丝绸。中世纪时，驻塔位于附近的费尔本领主在这一地区拥有影响。

1495年，费尔伯谷尽头发生大规模山崩，形成欣特湖。1635年瘟疫袭击米特西尔，1746年的大火几乎烧毁整个集镇，教区教堂也严重受损。法国战争期间，当地民兵与蒂罗尔人并肩在施特鲁布山口作战。萨尔察河洪水不断威胁城镇，1830年代居民开始修筑堤坝。

english: Mityakinskaya is an old Don Cossack settlement in the steppe country near the Seversky Donets. Its foundation is traditionally dated to 1549, when Cossacks under the leader Ivan Mityaka are said to have fought Tatars in the area. The settlement bears his name and recalls the early Cossack communities that established fortified places along the rivers of the Don basin. Their river routes connected scattered settlements through a frontier contested by steppe powers and Muscovy.
simp_chinese: 米佳金斯卡亚是北顿涅茨河附近草原上的古老顿河哥萨克聚落。传统将其建立追溯至1549年，相传当时伊万·米佳卡率哥萨克在此与鞑靼人作战。聚落以他为名，使人想起早期哥萨克社群沿顿河流域河流建立的设防据点。河道将散布各处的聚落连接起来，这片边疆也为草原诸势力与莫斯科所争夺。

english: The forested mountains of western New Britain rise between the island’s northern and southern coasts. Rivers cut valleys through the tropical interior before reaching the sea. The wider region is home to communities speaking Lamogai and other languages of the Bismarck Archipelago.
simp_chinese: 新不列颠岛西部森林覆盖的山脉耸立于南北海岸之间。河流在热带内陆切出谷地，最终流入大海。广大地区是使用拉莫盖语及俾斯麦群岛其他语言的社群的家园。

english: Miwa country belongs to the northern Kimberley around the Drysdale River and neighbouring coast. Miwa people maintained relationships with Kwini, Ngarinyin and Gamberre neighbours. Large hunts could bring groups together, with dances shared between communities and carried on journeys across the region.
simp_chinese: 米瓦地区位于金伯利北部德赖斯代尔河及邻近海岸一带。米瓦人与奎尼、恩加林因和甘贝雷邻居保持联系。大型狩猎活动可以聚集不同群体，舞蹈在社群间分享，并随着人们穿越地区的旅程传播。

english:
Mixian belongs to the country southwest of Zhengzhou, where hills and cultivated valleys connect the central Henan plain with the approaches to the Songshan region. Farming households grew grain and other crops, kept livestock, and used local resources to supplement production. Roads linked villages with markets and administrative centers, allowing food, tools, textiles, and travelers to move between districts. The meeting of hill and plain encouraged exchange among communities with different opportunities.

During the Ming and Qing periods, Mixian's county administration organised taxes, justice and public obligations. Its county yamen had served as the seat of government since the Sui period and retained buildings associated with Ming and Qing administration. Temples, family institutions and village associations also shaped local life, while warfare and environmental pressures could interrupt cultivation and trade.
simp_chinese:
密县属于郑州西南地区，丘陵和耕作谷地把河南中部平原同嵩山周边连接起来。农户种植谷物及其他作物，养畜并利用地方资源补充生产。道路连接村庄、市场和行政中心，使食物、工具、纺织品及旅人在辖区间移动。山地与平原交会，促进机会不同的社群交换，居民劳动因而参与更广地区生活。

明清时期，密县县级机构管理赋税、司法与公共义务。县衙自隋代起作为县治处所，现存建筑保留明清官署的布局和风格。寺庙、家族与村落组织也影响地方生活，战争和环境压力则可能中断耕作与贸易。

english: Mixquiahuala was an Otomi town in the Mezquital valley. Its Nahuatl name refers to a place surrounded by mesquite trees. Under Mexica rule the town paid tribute to Tenochtitlan; after the Spanish conquest it was divided among colonial encomenderos. A late sixteenth-century pictorial map places Mixquiahuala and its church within the surrounding territory, preserving a record of the community and its lands.
simp_chinese: 米斯基亚瓦拉是梅斯基塔尔谷地的一座奥托米人城镇。其纳瓦特尔语地名意为“蜜荆环绕之地”。在墨西加统治下，城镇向特诺奇蒂特兰进贡；西班牙征服后，它被分配给殖民征赋领主。一幅十六世纪末的绘图将米斯基亚瓦拉及其教堂置于周围土地之中，保存了社区和土地的记录。

english: Mixtlan was a settlement in the Papaloapan basin associated with the old lordship of Guaspaltepec. After the Spanish conquest, the indigenous communities of the region were placed under colonial rule and distributed in encomiendas. Guaspaltepec was eventually abandoned, and its inhabitants moved to Mixtlan, while the priest took up residence at Chacaltianguis. The change left the old administrative centre without its population.
simp_chinese: 米斯特兰是帕帕洛阿潘流域的一处聚落，与旧时的瓜斯帕尔特佩克领地有关。西班牙征服后，该地区的原住民社区受到殖民统治，被分配为监护征赋地。瓜斯帕尔特佩克后来被弃，居民迁往米斯特兰，神父则移居查卡尔蒂安吉斯，旧行政中心因而失去了人口。

english:
Miyagi lies on the Sendai plain of Mutsu, between the mountains and the Pacific. Its rivers and roads made it a natural centre for the surrounding country. Above the Hirose River, a wooded height became the site of Sendai Castle, the seat of the Date lords and the heart of a thriving castle town on the plain below.

After the Battle of Sekigahara, Date Masamune received permission to move his residence from Iwadeyama. Work on the castle and town began in 1601, drawing residents from his former seat and labourers from nearby villages. Cliffs, woodland and a gorge protected the hilltop stronghold. Masamune's successor Tadamune built a new enclosure at the foot of the hill, which became the domain's administrative centre in 1639.
simp_chinese:
宫城位于陆奥仙台平原，介于群山和太平洋之间。河流与道路使它成为周围地区的自然中心。广濑川上方的林木高地建起仙台城，成为伊达诸侯的居所和繁荣城下町的核心。

关原之战后，伊达政宗获准从岩出山迁移居城。1601年城郭与町镇开始动工，旧居城居民及附近村民被召来建设。悬崖、森林和峡谷保护着山上的要塞；政宗的继承人忠宗在山麓兴建二之丸，1639年起成为藩政中心。

english: Miyako Cape extends from the western coast of Amami Ōshima into the East China Sea. Strong winds limit the growth of tall trees on its exposed heights, leaving low Ryūkyū bamboo and flowering shrubs across the headland. Islanders call the bamboo sasanto and have used its leaves to thatch roofs. Below the cape lie reefs and fishing waters along Amami's rugged shore.
simp_chinese: 宫古崎从奄美大岛西岸伸入东海。强风抑制高大树木生长，岬角高处覆盖着低矮的琉球竹和开花灌木。岛民称这种竹为萨桑托，曾用竹叶铺盖屋顶。岬角下方是奄美崎岖海岸旁的礁石和渔场。

english: Miyakojima lies between Okinawa and the Yaeyama Islands, surrounded by warm subtropical seas. Its leader Nakasone Toyomiya guided the Ryūkyū royal forces against Oyake Akahachi in 1500 and was appointed head of Miyako for his service. His descendants held important offices on the island. From 1637 the Shuri government imposed a poll tax on Miyako and Yaeyama, demanding grain and later cloth from islanders under a heavy fiscal burden.
simp_chinese: 宫古岛位于冲绳与八重山群岛之间，四周是温暖的亚热带海域。1500年，当地首长仲宗根丰见亲为讨伐远弥计赤蜂的琉球王军引路，因功获任宫古头职，其后代在岛上担任重要官职。1637年起，首里王府向宫古和八重山征收人头税，要求岛民缴纳谷物，后来又加征布匹，负担沉重。

english: Miyaneh lies near the Qezel Uzan, where the river turns east through the highlands of Azerbaijan toward the Safidrud valley. The town commands a route between the Iranian interior and Tabriz. East of it, the bridge of Qaflankuh spans the river beneath a mountain fortress; an inscription records its completion in 1484. Another bridge over the Qaranqu dates from Safavid times and was later rebuilt under the Qajars.
simp_chinese: 米亚内位于克孜尔乌赞河附近，河流在此转向东，穿过阿塞拜疆高地通往萨菲德河谷。城镇控制着伊朗内陆与大不里士之间的道路。城东的卡夫兰库赫桥横跨河流，山地堡垒俯瞰桥梁；铭文记载其于1484年完工。另一座横跨卡兰古河的桥建于萨法维时期，后来在卡扎尔时代重建。

english: Miyazaki lies on the Pacific side of Hyūga, where the plain meets the wooded hills of southern Kyushu. In 1446 Itō Suketaka captured Miyazaki Castle as his family expanded from Tonokōri across the plain. The Itō later lost their lands to the Shimazu, but after Toyotomi Hideyoshi's Kyushu campaign Itō Suketake (Sukebe) received lands including Kiyotake in Miyazaki district. These became part of the holdings of the Obi domain.
simp_chinese: 宫崎位于日向的太平洋一侧，平原与九州南部的林木丘陵在此相接。1446年，伊东祐堯攻下宫崎城，其家族从都於郡向平原扩张。伊东氏后来失地于岛津氏，丰臣秀吉征服九州后，伊东祐兵又获赐宫崎郡清武等地，成为飫肥藩领地的一部分。

english: Miyoshi stands in the inland basin of northern Bingo, where rivers meet and roads converge. In 1632 Asano Nagaharu received a separate domain here and laid out a town using the surrounding rivers as natural defences. He encouraged industries including hemp, paper, cotton, lacquer and iron. The Asano branch ruled Miyoshi for five generations, until the domain ended without an heir in 1720 and its lands returned to Hiroshima domain.
simp_chinese: 三次位于备后北部的内陆盆地，河流与道路在此交会。1632年，浅野长治在这里获得分封，营建城下町，以周围河流作为天然防御。他还鼓励麻、纸、棉、漆和铁等产业。浅野氏的这一支统治三次五代，直到1720年因无继承人而废藩，领地归还广岛藩。

english: Miyoshi occupies the rugged interior of western Awa, where the Iya River cuts a deep valley through forested mountains before joining the Yoshino. Bridges woven from vines once crossed its ravines, offering a passage between steep banks. Legend says that defeated Heike warriors hid in Iya and made bridges that could be cut to stop pursuit. Several such crossings served the valley's scattered communities during the Edo period.
simp_chinese: 三好位于阿波西部崎岖的内陆。祖谷川穿过森林山地，切出深谷，随后汇入吉野川。当地曾以藤蔓编成吊桥，连接两侧陡岸。传说败逃的平家武士藏身祖谷，造出可以割断以阻止追兵的桥梁。江户时代，数座藤桥为谷中分散的聚落提供通路。

english: Miyun lies northeast of Beijing, where the roads to the northern frontier pass through mountain valleys. Gubeikou, on the Chao River, was one of the important gateways through these ranges. The Ming strengthened its walls and passes, and the general Qi Jiguang later rebuilt sections of the Great Wall and added watchtowers. In 1572 he held a major military exercise in the river valley near the pass.
simp_chinese: 密云位于北京东北，通往北方边境的道路穿过山谷。潮河边的古北口是山岭间的重要关隘。明代在此修筑关城与长城，戚继光后来加固城墙、增建敌楼，并于1572年在关口附近的潮河川举行大规模军事演练。

english: Mizantla lies between the mountains and the coastal plain of Veracruz, in a region with a long Totonac history. Its older settlement stood in the hills at a place later called Pueblo Viejo. Franciscan missionaries sought to bring dispersed communities together, and in 1564 the inhabitants were moved to a new site near the rivers of the district. The move reshaped the town as colonial authorities organized the surrounding Indigenous population.
simp_chinese: 米桑特拉位于韦拉克鲁斯山地与海岸平原之间，所在地区有悠久的托托纳克历史。旧聚落坐落在山中，后来称为旧村。方济各会传教士试图将分散社群集中起来，1564年居民被迁往地区河流附近的新地点。这次迁移重塑了城镇，也反映出殖民当局对周围原住民人口的重新组织。

english: Mizda is a small oasis south of the Nafusa Mountains, on a route between Tripoli and Fezzan. Its wells and gardens offer a stopping place before the long crossing of the stony desert. One of the principal caravan roads from Tripoli to Murzuq passed through Mizda, while another ran farther east through Bani Walid. The oasis thus belonged to a network of routes carrying people and goods between the Mediterranean and the central Sahara.
simp_chinese: 米兹达是奈富塞山脉以南的一处小绿洲，位于的黎波里与费赞之间的道路上。水井和园圃为穿越漫长砾石荒漠的旅人提供歇脚之地。从的黎波里通往穆尔祖格的主要商队道路之一经过米兹达，另一条则经更东面的拜尼沃利德。这处绿洲因而属于连接地中海与撒哈拉中部、运送人员和货物的道路网络。

english: Mizen Head marks the end of a rocky peninsula on Ireland's southwestern coast. Cliffs rise above Atlantic waters, and the headland offers a conspicuous landmark for ships approaching from the west or rounding the coast toward Cork. The exposed shore is subject to heavy seas and Atlantic storms. In 1804 a signal tower was built on the Mizen as part of a coastal chain intended to give warning of a feared French invasion, linking this remote headland to the defence of Ireland during the Napoleonic wars.
simp_chinese: 米曾角位于爱尔兰西南海岸一条岩石半岛的尽头。悬崖高出大西洋海面，为从西方驶来或绕岸前往科克的船只提供醒目的地标。这片无遮蔽的海岸常受大浪与大西洋风暴侵袭。1804年，人们在米曾角建造信号塔，纳入沿岸警报链，以防法国入侵；拿破仑战争期间，偏远岬角由此成为爱尔兰海防的一环。

english: Mizhi lies in the loess hills of northern Shaanxi, where streams cut deeply into the plateau. Once a fortified settlement on the Song frontier with Western Xia, it became a county under the Jin. The Yuan incorporated neighbouring Dingrong into Mizhi, and the county remained under Suide through the Ming. In the seventeenth century Mizhi was the home district of Li Zicheng, whose uprising grew from the troubles of the late Ming into a campaign across much of China. After establishing the Shun regime at Xi'an in 1643, Li renamed his native county Tianbao. The Qing restored the name Mizhi, preserving the older name of this frontier settlement.
simp_chinese: 米脂位于陕北黄土丘陵，溪流深切台塬。这里曾是宋夏边境上的寨堡，金代升为县；元朝将邻近定戎并入米脂，明代仍隶属绥德。十七世纪，米脂人李自成从明末动乱中起兵，势力逐渐遍及中国多地。他于1643年在西安建立大顺政权后，将故乡米脂改名天保。清代恢复米脂之名，使这座旧边地县城沿用更古老的名称。

english:
Mizque lies in a valley of the Bolivian Andes, south of Cochabamba. The Spanish town was founded in 1603 by Francisco de Alfaro under the name Salinas del Río Pisuerga. It became an ecclesiastical centre associated with the bishopric of Santa Cruz de la Sierra: its first bishop, Antonio Calderón, arrived in Mizque in 1609.

The town's role connected the valley with a diocese extending eastward into the lowlands. Mizque remained associated with the bishopric through much of the colonial period, illustrating the importance of its inland position to religious administration and travel between the Andes and Santa Cruz.
simp_chinese:
米斯克位于玻利维亚安第斯山脉的河谷中，在科恰班巴以南。西班牙城镇由弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔法罗于1603年建立，原名萨利纳斯德尔里奥皮苏埃尔加。它成为与圣克鲁斯德拉谢拉主教区相关的教会中心：首任主教安东尼奥·卡尔德龙于1609年抵达米斯克。

这一地位将河谷与向东延伸至低地的教区联系起来。殖民时期的大部分时间里，米斯克与该主教区保持密切关系，其内陆位置对安第斯与圣克鲁斯之间的宗教行政和交通具有意义。

english: Long and narrow, Mjøsa is Norway's largest lake. It lies between fertile shores and carries traffic towards Gudbrandsdalen at its northern end. In summer people travelled by boat, while in winter horses and sledges crossed the ice. Farmers around the lake were obliged to build and crew royal boats for officials on their journeys; such vessels are mentioned in records from the seventeenth century.
simp_chinese: 狭长的米约萨湖是挪威最大的湖泊，肥沃的土地环绕湖岸，湖上交通通向北端的古德布兰兹达伦。夏季人们乘船往来，冬季则以马匹和雪橇穿行于冰面。沿湖农民有义务建造并操持供官员出行的王家船只；17世纪的文献已有这类船的记载。

english: Mkwaja lies on the East African coast, south of the Pangani River, where the Indian Ocean meets a landscape of grassland and coastal woodland. The shore faces the islands of Zanzibar across a narrow channel. Inland, seasonal streams and the Pangani connect the coast with the foothills of the Usambara Mountains, while the sea forms part of the maritime world of the Swahili towns.
simp_chinese: 姆夸贾位于东非海岸、潘加尼河以南，印度洋在这里与草地和海岸林地相接。海岸隔着狭窄水道面向桑给巴尔群岛。内陆的季节性溪流与潘加尼河把海岸连接到乌桑巴拉山麓；海上则是斯瓦希里城镇共同的航海世界。

english:
Mladá Boleslav stands above the Jizera in central Bohemia, on the site of a stronghold founded by Duke Boleslaus II. A settlement grew below it on the road from Prague toward Lusatia, and in 1334 the market was moved beside the castle and raised to the rank of a town. During the Hussite Wars its inhabitants supported the Taborites.

In the late fifteenth century the Unity of the Brethren settled in a deserted monastery, beginning a period of prosperity. The town became a centre of the Brethren, with a bishop, a Renaissance church and a printing house. In 1518 Mikuláš Klaudyán printed the first map of Bohemia here. The town also had a Jewish community, recorded from 1471; Emperor Rudolf II raised Mladá Boleslav to the status of a royal city in 1600.
simp_chinese:
姆拉达博莱斯拉夫位于波希米亚中部伊泽拉河上方，其旧址曾是博莱斯拉夫二世公爵建立的堡寨。堡下聚落处于从布拉格通往卢萨蒂亚的道路上，逐渐发展起来。1334年，集市迁至城堡前，并升格为城镇。胡斯战争期间，当地居民支持塔博尔派。

十五世纪末，兄弟会在一座废弃修道院定居，城镇由此迎来繁荣时期。这里成为兄弟会的重要中心，设有主教驻地、文艺复兴式教堂和印刷所。1518年，米库拉什·克劳迪扬在此印出第一幅波希米亚地图。当地还有犹太社群，自1471年起见于记载；1600年，皇帝鲁道夫二世将姆拉达博莱斯拉夫升为王室城市。

english: Mlungo lies near Kundabwika Falls on the Kalungwishi River. Rising on the Kasama–Mporokoso plateau, the Kalungwishi passes a series of waterfalls before reaching Lake Mweru. Rock paintings near Kundabwika bear witness to earlier inhabitants of the river country. The Kalungwishi is one of Mweru's largest tributaries after the Luapula.
simp_chinese: 姆伦戈靠近卡伦圭希河上的昆达布维卡瀑布。卡伦圭希河发源于卡萨马—姆波罗科索高原，穿过一系列瀑布后流入姆韦鲁湖；除卢阿普拉河外，它是该湖最大的支流之一。昆达布维卡附近还有岩画，留下了久远居民在这片河流地带活动的痕迹。

english: Mnihaha lies near Lake Poinsett and the upper Big Sioux River in eastern Dakota country. The area between the lake and the Oakwood Lakes was used as a summer hunting ground by Sioux communities. Lake Poinsett drains toward the Big Sioux, whose wooded course runs south across the prairie. The lakes and river occupy low ground left by the glaciers that shaped this part of the plains.
simp_chinese: 姆尼哈哈位于达科他东部，靠近波因塞特湖与大苏河北段。波因塞特湖与奥克伍德湖群之间曾是苏族社群的夏季猎场。湖水通向大苏河，河道林木繁茂，向南穿过草原。湖泊与河流位于平原上的低地中，这片地形由冰川塑造。
